note: Per-writer-life final counters read directly from writer_progress-<life>.json (42 lives, index 0..41). Included because scripts/longevity_run.py::summarize() aggregates unlabeled writer counters (writer_errors_total, appends_total, corrections_applied_total, corrections_skipped_total, compactions_total, artifact_checks/invalidations/refreshes_total, compactions_throttled_total) via counter_latest, which keys solely on (metric_name, labels_json) and keeps only the latest-timestamp sample for a key -- since every writer life reports these counters under the SAME empty-label key, a run with restarts silently discards every life but the last one. The manifest's summary.error_count (1) and summary.writer_final (life 41 only) both reflect only the final life; they are not full-run totals.
